name: Brick Mill Furniture
old_description: Built-to-order, designed for your space, and crafted for homes that value quality over trends.
about:
Brick Mill Furniture operates from Williamsport, Pennsylvania, a city once known as the lumber capital of the world. The company crafts each piece by hand in its local workshop at 315 West Third Street, drawing on the region’s woodworking heritage.

The shop produces made-to-order solid hardwood furniture for dining rooms, bedrooms, home offices, and living spaces. Every item is built from lumber milled on-site from sustainably sourced local logs, using traditional joinery techniques and durable finishes. Customers select wood species, dimensions, and details to fit their space. The company also offers an epoxy line for live-edge designs. Orders ship via free FedEx curbside delivery, with an optional white-glove service; some pieces require simple assembly with included tools.

Brick Mill sells directly to residential customers seeking heirloom-quality pieces, as well as to commercial clients outfitting offices with conference tables and desks. Its showroom serves local visitors, while the online store reaches buyers nationwide. The firm emphasizes design assistance and dedicated support for each project.

The business was founded on a promise to create furniture that lasts for generations, rejecting veneers and particle board in favor of solid wood and time-honored craftsmanship. Its differentiators include an owned lumber mill, full customization, and a focus on legacy-grade construction.
